name: consumer_mems
source: ILLUSTRATIVE VALUES OF A CONSUMER MEMS SUITE, NOT A CALIBRATED INSTRUMENT. IMU terms are the IEEE Std 952-2020 Allan-variance terms at the magnitudes a consumer MEMS datasheet states (noise density 400 ug/sqrt(Hz) = 0.235 m/s/sqrt(h) VRW; 0.005 dps/sqrt(Hz) = 0.3 deg/sqrt(h) ARW), the bias instabilities and repeatabilities at survey-typical values for the grade; the GPS numbers follow a consumer receiver's stated CEP class; pitot-static and magnetometer numbers are hand-chosen within the ranges the cited documents describe as typical. Every number is 'unverified here'.
references: Groves, P. D. (2013), Principles of GNSS, Inertial, and Multisensor Integrated Navigation Systems, 2nd ed., Artech House, Table 4.1 (consumer grade: gyro bias >100 deg/h, accelerometer bias >10 mg) -- unverified here
El-Sheimy, N., Hou, H., Niu, X. (2008), Analysis and Modeling of Inertial Sensors Using Allan Variance, IEEE Trans. Instrumentation and Measurement 57(1) -- unverified here
Woodman, O. J. (2007), An introduction to inertial navigation, UCAM-CL-TR-696 -- unverified here

InvenSense MPU-6050 Product Specification rev 3.4 (gyro rate noise spectral density 0.005 dps/sqrt(Hz); accelerometer noise power spectral density 400 ug/sqrt(Hz)) -- public datasheet, unverified here
u-blox NEO-M8 data sheet (horizontal position accuracy 2.5 m CEP; velocity accuracy 0.05 m/s; navigation update rate up to 10 Hz, 5 Hz typical) -- public datasheet, unverified here
